description: This Scala source file defines the BlockManagerDecommissioner class responsible for handling block manager decommissioning retries in Apache Spark. It manages migration of RDD cache and shuffle blocks, including thread management, migration retries, and shutdown procedures.

classes.name: BlockManagerDecommissioner
classes.description: Manages decommissioning and migration of blocks in Spark, including handling shuffle and RDD cache blocks, thread management, and migration state tracking.

classes.name: ShuffleMigrationRunnable
classes.description: Runnable class for migrating shuffle blocks to a specific peer, with retry logic and error handling.

methods.name: refreshMigratableShuffleBlocks
methods.description: Updates the queue of shuffles to be migrated, manages migration threads, and determines if migration should continue.

methods.name: stopMigratingShuffleBlocks
methods.description: Gracefully stops the shuffle block migration process and associated threads.

methods.name: decommissionRddCacheBlocks
methods.description: Migrates RDD cache blocks to other block managers during decommissioning, returns whether there are blocks left to migrate.

methods.name: migrateBlock
methods.description: Attempts to replicate a specific block to another block manager and removes it upon success.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the migration threads for RDD and shuffle blocks.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all migration threads and processes.

methods.name: lastMigrationInfo
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last migration and whether all blocks have been migrated.
